key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to fetch usage data, in seconds (900-86400).

key.name: display-mode
key.description: How to display usage in the panel: text, bar, or both.

key.name: panel-time-display-mode
key.description: How to display reset time in the panel: remaining countdown in "1h30m" form, remaining countdown in "1:30" form (hours rolled up), or recovery clock time.

key.name: panel-window-mode
key.description: Which usage window to show in the panel: primary (first), worst (highest usage), or all.

key.name: show-provider-icon
key.description: Whether to show provider icons in the top bar.

key.name: icon-style
key.description: Icon rendering style: color or monochrome.

key.name: accounts-json
key.description: JSON array of account objects: [{id, provider, name, config}].

key.name: credential-revision
key.description: Internal counter incremented when stored credentials change.

key.name: hidden-account-ids
key.description: List of account IDs to hide from the panel and menu. An empty list means every account is visible.

key.name: visible-account-ids
key.description: Deprecated legacy whitelist of visible account IDs. Migrated to hidden-account-ids on first run and no longer read; retained only for one-time migration.

key.name: enable-notifications
key.description: Show a desktop notification when an account crosses the high-usage threshold or resets below it.

key.name: proxy-url
key.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for API requests. Leave empty for direct connection.
